title: IF Staining for CD68
author: Eduard Bentea
materials: 250 µl blocking step : in 1 x PBS 0.1% Tergitol (ThermoScientific; 464252500; CAS: 68131-40-8) (PBS-T) + 10% Donkey serum (Jackson Immuno Research; 017-000-121; RRID: AB2337258) (accordingly to the secondary Abs) 00:40:00 incubation on the wobbler.
250 µl Primary Ab CD68 (Abcam; Ab 125212; RRID: AB_10975465) 1:500 in 1 x PBS-T + 10% Donkey serum (accordingly to the secondary Abs) Overnight at Room temperature on the wobbler.

steps.title: Add citrate buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 1 M citrate buffer (pH 6) to each well, ensuring the tissue lies flat and is completely in contact with the buffer.

steps.title: Incubate tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue in the citrate buffer for 30 minutes at 80 °C, then place the plate on ice for an additional 20 minutes in the same buffer.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of secondary antibody diluted 1:500 in 1× PBS‑T, incubate for 2 hours at room temperature on a wobbler protected from light by covering with aluminium foil.

steps.title: Rinse and mount sections
steps.instruction: Briefly rinse sections in a 1:1 mixture of PBS and AD, mount them on Avantor VWR frosted microscope slides (catalog 631‑1551), and allow to dry overnight while covered.

steps.title: Apply mowiol and DAPI
steps.instruction: Cover each slide with 80 µL of Mowiol containing DAPI at 1:500 (nuclear stain, 405 nm), place a #1.5 cover slip (Epredia; BB02400500SC13MNZ0), and let dry overnight.

steps.title: Rinse with PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the sections with PBS (Gibco; catalog 21600‑096).

steps.title: Visualize stained sections
steps.instruction: Observe the stained sections using a Leica DM6 B LED fluorescent microscope and the LasX software.
